title: Kitter's Enhanced Vanilla
body:
I have created this modpack to add to the vanilla expierience. Included are many different performance mods such as Sodium and ImmediatelyFast, Iris for shaders, and a variety of shaders and packs to use!

The modpack can be played in multiplayer if you wish, and does not add many new items or mobs. When I created this I focused on looks and simplicity specifically.

The modpack has been tested on an integrated graphics old Intel computer, and was able to run well.

If you have suggestions or want to report a bug, please contact me on Discord at: _1_cat_on_crack_
